summary: xAI announced a partnership making Grok Voice the default text-to-speech and speech-to-text engine for Vapi's voice agent platform, which hosts over 2.5 million voice agents.

mechanisms.reason: Grok Voice becoming the default engine across a platform with millions of existing voice agents expands the volume of inference served by Grok's voice model.
mechanisms.quote: we're excited to announce a partnership with Vapi to serve as the default engine for Vapi's 12 core voices, bringing a new level of naturalness and emotional range to the 2.5M+ voice agents built on the Vapi platform.

practices.reason: The blind arena-style comparison method used by Vapi to rank voice providers is a transferable evaluation approach worth noting even though the result is not independently reproduced here.
practices.quote: Vapi conducted an independent, blind evaluation comparing Grok Voice against other providers. In their head-to-head arena, Grok took the #1 spot.

practices.reason: Vapi developers gain a new dropdown option and dashboard access to Grok's speech-to-text and text-to-speech, an optional integration change rather than a required migration.
practices.quote: Grok Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech are now available in the Vapi Dashboard.
